calls.video_title: Adobe Stock: Cheapest in a Decade Despite Record Profits
calls.price_at_call: Market ~$250 (stated); his buy limit $270; base-scenario fair value ~50% above current (~$375); bear-scenario fair value ~$190
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked ADBE call for him. Record profits, P/E compressed from ~50 to ~14 while revenue grew $4bn to $24bn since 2013; 96% recurring subscription revenue, ~$5.8bn FCF in 9 months, heavy buybacks. Staying invested and considering adding more, but not a large position — AI disruption risk and recent management turnover keep it small.
calls.base_case: Revenue keeps growing ~11%/yr for 5 years, then ~8%; fair P/E 17; ~12% annual returns over 10 years.
calls.bull_case: Fair price over 140% higher if growth holds and the market re-rates off a 14x P/E.
calls.bear_case: Even with earnings -2%/yr for 5 years then stagnation and a 10x P/E, returns stay ~+3%/yr; moat narrows as Canva, Affinity and AI image tools pull smaller users away.

calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value $360 (revised slightly higher from $349 on 2 Nov) vs market $251 (~40% undervalued); forward P/E 9.1
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 2 Nov) — ranked one of the best stocks to buy right now; deep discount prices in continued deceleration despite double-digit top-line growth and an entrenched customer base.
calls.base_case: Freemium shift working (100M+ monthly active users, +70% YoY) and analyst EPS growth estimates revised up to ~14% from ~13%; high switching costs blunt the AI threat.
calls.bull_case: Freemium momentum keeps converting and the market re-rates a double-digit grower off a 9.1 forward P/E.
calls.bear_case: AI effectiveness is one of the largest risk factors of any company he follows and threatens Adobe's business model and customer base.
